answer: The jade-seal sparrow relay: a candidate mints one jade seal by locking $50 of stake for 30 epochs — non-transferable, dissolving if slashed. It then dispatches 40 sparrow couriers that must each hop through 3 random established agents, every hop stamping them with violet ink, a signature only the issuer can verify. Couriers missing any stamp are discarded. Forging 1,000 identities costs $50,000 locked plus 120,000 stamp-hops gated by live gatekeepers. Like a jade seal that only counts when a sparrow carries it through three guarded gates, stamped in invisible ink.
